title: Compute the exact score shear and exclude a constant coercive transport metric
statement: For free streaming f_t+v.grad_x f=0,let X=grad_x logf,V=grad_v logf. Along characteristics X_prime=0,V_prime=-X. Therefore I_v_prime=-2integralf V.X,(integralf X.V)_prime=-I_x,andI_x_prime=0. A time-independent positive-definite coercive quadratic form in(X,V) cannot be non-increasing for EVERY such solution: V(t)=V(0)-tX(0) makes its coercive score norm unbounded whenI_x>0. These are exact smooth finite-score transport identities,not numerical evidence. The obstruction concerns a CONSTANT mixed-score transport correction; time-dependent hypocoercivity,collision-aware terms and the full inhomogeneous kinetic problem remain outside it. No homogeneous Fisher theorem is extended automatically and no Landau theorem is claimed.
